photos.desc: Original backbone and replica of humerus of a sauropod ( Zby atlanticus MATEUS et al. 2014). Lourinhã Formation (Late Jurassic). Museu da Lourinhã (central-west Portugal).
Entrance of the Museu da Lourinhã (collections of archeology, palethnology and paleontology), with the cast of the forelimb of a sauropod found into the Lourinhã Formation (Late Jurassic).
